name: RCA-Bench v1.0
description: RCA-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating whether large language models (LLMs) select appropriate levels of autonomy when responding to organizational requests. It uses a two-gate decision framework distinguishing human-reserved substantive decisions from execution authorization, with three possible autonomy outcomes: ACT, CONFIRM, and ESCALATE. The benchmark contains 60 expert-validated organizational scenarios across six domains. The accompanying experimental dataset comprises 1,440 valid responses from four LLMs evaluated under Baseline and Agent Delegation Policy (ADP)-guided prompting conditions, with three repetitions per scenario. The repository includes benchmark scenarios, expert-established reference labels, experimental responses, prompting procedures, execution configurations, reproducibility scripts, statistical analysis, and supporting audit documentation. The overall classification accuracy was 87.92%. Although ADP-guided prompting produced a descriptive improvement, the scenario-cluster bootstrap confidence intervals did not establish a statistically conclusive improvement. The package is intended to support transparent evaluation, independent verification, and future research on risk-calibrated autonomy, human oversight, and authorization-aware AI agents. The included documentation specifies the scope of the licenses, known reproducibility limitations, and considerations concerning third-party model outputs.
